items.title: Nvidia-backed Groq seeks $8 billion valuation in new funding round - Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nvidia-backed artificial intelligence infrastructure company Groq is seeking fresh funding at an $8 billion valuation, more than doubling its valuation in three months despite a selloff in publicly traded data center operators, Bloomberg reported exclusively, citing investor documents.
